description: This file implements the backend logic for editing custom fields within the TestLink project. It handles actions such as creating, editing, updating, deleting, and displaying custom field configurations, as well as initializing the GUI and processing user input. The code interacts with database managers and templates to manage custom field metadata and display the appropriate forms to administrators.

methods.name: getCFCfg
methods.description: Initializes and returns the custom field configuration object, including default empty values and configuration options retrieved from the cfield_mgr.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes and returns the GUI structure for the custom field editing interface by invoking cfield_mgr's initViewGUI method.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific custom field for editing, including usage status and linked test projects, and prepares data for rendering.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Processes creation of a new custom field based on user input, performs validation, and links to test projects if requested.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Processes updates to an existing custom field, ensuring name uniqueness and saving changes to the database.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes a specified custom field and logs the deletion event.

methods.name: cfieldCfgInit
methods.description: Creates and returns the configuration object for custom fields, including application areas, enable/show options, allowed nodes, and possible values.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Determines whether to render the GUI and displays the appropriate Smarty template with the current data.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the necessary rights to manage custom fields.
